defineTerrainSeg

Source: R/terrainSegModel.R
defineTerrainSeg.Rd

CNN-based semantic segmentation wrapper that generates LSPs from a DTM and passes them to a user-supplied trainable segmentation model.

Usage

defineTerrainSeg(
  segMod,
  cellSize = 1,
  spatDim = 640,
  tCrop = 64,
  doGP = FALSE,
  innerRadius = 2,
  outerRadius = 10,
  hsRadius = 50,
  smoothRadius = 11
)

Arguments

segMod

An already-instantiated trainable segmentation model (torch nn_module). Must accept the number of input channels produced by the LSP module: 6 when doGP = FALSE, 31 when doGP = TRUE.

cellSize

Input resolution of DTM data in map units. Default is 1.

spatDim

Spatial dimension (height = width) of the input chip in cells. Default is 640.

tCrop

Number of rows and columns to crop from each side of the LSP output before passing to the segmentation model. This removes edge artefacts introduced by the convolution-based LSP calculations. Default is 64.

doGP

Whether to compute Gaussian Pyramids of the DTM and derive LSPs at multiple scales. Default is FALSE. If FALSE, 6 LSPs are passed to the model. If TRUE, 31 LSPs are passed.

innerRadius

Inner radius (cells) of the annulus window used for local TPI calculation. Default is 2.

outerRadius

Outer radius (cells) of the annulus window used for local TPI calculation. Default is 10.

hsRadius

Radius (cells) of the circular moving window for hillslope TPI calculation. Default is 50.

smoothRadius

Radius (cells) of the circular moving window used to smooth the DTM before curvature calculations. Default is 11.

Value

A terrainSeg nn_module wrapping the LSP pipeline and the supplied segmentation model.

Details

Define a CNN-based semantic segmentation model for landform extraction or classification. The module generates land surface parameters (LSPs) from the input DTM, crops the LSP tensor to remove edge artefacts, and then passes the result to an externally instantiated trainable segmentation model. The model assumes a single-band DTM of elevation measurements as input.

When doGP = FALSE the LSP module produces 6 channels; when doGP = TRUE it produces 31 channels. The segmentation model supplied via segMod must be instantiated with a matching inChn value and with an inChn that accounts for the spatial reduction caused by tCrop (input chip size minus 2 * tCrop).
